title: Clinic-gated accessible rehabilitation transport
brief: Arrange accessible transport for my September 3, 2027, 10:00 rehabilitation appointment in the Chicago test district; arrive 30 minutes early and confirm the return after the visit. Ask me about access needs, limits and authorization; verify lift, securement and companion capacity with dispatch, book the outbound first, and book the return only after the clinic records my actual release - never the estimated end time. Share pickup and access needs only, not my diagnosis. No payment.

pages.title: Access Ride Coordination Portal
pages.text: Synthetic clinic and accessible-transport records for the Chicago test district: appointment logistics, the lift-equipped fleet and the booking desks. Current appointment state is read through the clinic portal service (clinic_portal) and live vehicle inventory through the ride search service (ride_search); fleet status and releases change without notice, so re-check before booking. The patient's constraints can be clarified through the patient desk (patient_dialogue). Written fleet verification comes from the dispatch desk by mail.
pages.snippet: Clinic appointment state, lift-equipped vehicle inventory and booking desks.

pages.title: Transport and clinic contacts
pages.text: Accessible-vehicle dispatch (fleet verification and bookings) is handled by Dana Whitfield; appointment logistics and release records by clinic coordinator Marcus Lee. Both answer daily during business hours.
pages.snippet: Contacts for the Access Ride dispatch desk and the Cedar Rehabilitation Clinic coordinator.

pages.title: Ride booking desks
pages.text: Each leg is booked through its own desk: the outbound desk (book_outbound) once the current verified vehicle is approved, and the return desk (book_return) only after the clinic records the actual release through clinic_portal. Each desk takes one current ride_search row; approve the exact vehicle and window for each leg with the patient first; at most one booking per leg and no payment. Stale vehicles are revalidated against live inventory at booking time.
pages.snippet: Outbound and return booking desks; the return is booked only after the actual clinic release.

authorization: Advisory and coordination only: search inventories, verify fleet capacity, and book at most the two approved legs; share pickup and access needs only - no diagnosis, medical records, medication advice or payment.

conclusion_options.both_legs_booked: Accessible outbound and post-release return both booked within budget
conclusion_options.unconfirmed: Vehicle access verification or the clinic release could not be obtained in time
conclusion_options.not_feasible: No current vehicle satisfies the access, timing and budget constraints
